# Arabic reading corpus

These 50 Arabic Wikipedia extracts were captured during the source investigation. Each record retains its article title, URL, revision, timestamp, topic and original passage. Arabic Wikipedia contributors provide this text under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The source URLs in the records identify each attributed revision. The JSON file is unchanged from the investigation archive.

The replay uses this fixed corpus to measure source coverage. Its assertions concern positive lesson yield and diversity. Live network behavior is checked separately by `tests/e2e/discovery.cjs`.
